newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tieto sees stable end-year earnings trend.
newsitem.headline: Tieto sees stable end-year earnings trend.

text.p: Finnish data services group TT Tieto Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it expected its end-year earnings trend to be stable, and forecast full-year 1996 net sales at slightly above two billion markka.
"Result development is ... expected to remain stable during the remaining part of the year," TT Tieto said in its January-September interim report.
"The net sales for the entire year are expected to be a little over two billion markka," it said. @
In 1995, the group's net sales amounted to 1.15 billion markka and profit before extrordinary items and tax was 96 billion markka.
